overloads.semanticRole: SET TEXT TO PASTEBOARD clears the pasteboard and then puts a copy of the text you passed in text into the pasteboard.

constraints: Clears the pasteboard before placing text; the text can be retrieved with Get text from pasteboard or GET PASTEBOARD DATA (e.g. "com.4d.private.text.native"); 4D text expressions can hold up to 2GB.
The pasteboard is read-only during the On Drag Over form event; this command cannot be used in that context.
